deliverables: Allocate capital to builders expected to improve monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Operate proposal evaluation, feedback coordination, transparent fund distribution, KPI reporting, and increasingly on-chain KPI verification.
Continue and improve DAO KPI dashboards and work with dReps to standardize KPI tracking.
Disburse funds only after milestone completion is validated and confirmed by the administrator.
Return unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds to the Cardano Treasury.
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with treasury withdrawal administered by an independent council/multisig composed of dRep DAO members before milestone-based disbursement.
request.what: Fund the Cardano Builder DAO as an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed funding mechanism for builder-led treasury allocation tied to Cardano Vision 2030 KPIs.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is designed to fund builders whose work can improve Cardano Vision 2030 KPIs including monthly active users, monthly transactions, and TVL.
Funded projects are required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions through public reporting and increasingly on-chain KPI verification.
The DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
Round 1 involved 38 voting members and 27 requesting members, funded 20 companies, had 83% governance participation, and distributed 5,541,335 ADA through a smart contract-governed process.
Round 2 added 18 new members, funded 14 companies after review and voting, and had 88% member participation.
The DAO created and amended governing documents, elected a board, added third-party assurance, implemented merit-based proposal review, and executed treasury withdrawals on-chain.
Official Cardano developer documentation describes the CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions.
An independent council including Cardano Yoda, Marco Grendel Moshi, and one additional non-affiliated active dRep is proposed to receive and oversee treasury funds before milestone disbursement.

ADA held by the administrator before disbursement will be kept in separate community-auditable accounts, not delegated to any stake pool operator, and delegated to the predefined abstain voting option.
The CB DAO returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after its first two governance rounds, with an adastat transaction link provided.

summary: The document requests 20,000,000 ADA to continue and scale the Cardano Builder DAO as a KPI-driven builder funding mechanism, relying mainly on asserted prior operating history, referenced governance materials, milestone-based administration, and a verifiable prior repayment transaction.
